title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #1 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these can help a child who is sad? (1 mark)
   A. Being rude to others
   B. Refusing to eat
   C. Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   D. Hiding alone for days

2. Which is an example of a good thought? (1 mark)
   A. I will take my friend's book
   B. I will not greet anyone
   C. I hope she falls
   D. I will help my mother with the dishes

3. What is a choice? (1 mark)
   A. A decision to do one thing instead of another
   B. A school rule
   C. A kind of food
   D. A gift from a friend

4. Which verse says that God's word is a lamp for our feet? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Psalm 119:105
   D. Acts 11:26

5. Why is it important to know your family members? (1 mark)
   A. So you can avoid them
   B. So you can forget them
   C. It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   D. So you can boast

6. What brings harmony in a family? (1 mark)
   A. Respect and love among members
   B. Selfishness
   C. Jealousy
   D. Fighting

7. If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it? (1 mark)
   A. The person who did wrong
   B. The parents
   C. The school
   D. The child

8. What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts? (1 mark)
   A. Yes please
   B. No, stop!
   C. Thank you
   D. Nothing

9. Which attribute comforts a child who is lonely? (1 mark)
   A. God is far away
   B. God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   C. God is angry
   D. God forgets us

10. Which verse says that God calls us by name? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Mark 10:52
   C. Exodus 20:12
   D. Isaiah 43:1

11. How many books are in the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 66
   C. 27
   D. 39

12. Which verse says that God has engraved His people on the palms of His hands? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Isaiah 49:16
   C. Genesis 1:27
   D. Acts 2:38

13. What did Zacchaeus promise to give to the poor? (1 mark)
   A. One tenth
   B. Half of his possessions
   C. Nothing
   D. All his possessions

14. How did the crowd react when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house? (1 mark)
   A. They cheered
   B. They were silent
   C. They grumbled
   D. They followed Zacchaeus

15. Which of these is kind treatment of a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Overloading it
   B. Giving it food, water and rest
   C. Beating it
   D. Leaving it hungry

16. What is a judge in the book of Judges? (1 mark)
   A. A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   B. A court officer today
   C. A king
   D. A priest

17. In which book of the Bible is the story of Samson found? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis
   B. Luke
   C. Judges
   D. Psalms

18. What is a famine? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A feast
   C. A river
   D. A long time when there is not enough food

19. What was Sarai's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Sarah
   B. Rachel
   C. Leah
   D. Rebekah

20. Which of these shows obedience like Abraham's? (1 mark)
   A. Waiting for others
   B. Arguing
   C. Following good instructions even when it is hard
   D. Ignoring instructions

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain why Joseph said, "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer". (3 marks)

22. Describe four ways in which God shows that He is a loving Father. (4 marks)

23. Explain what the story of Samson teaches and what it does not teach children to do. (5 marks)

24. Describe four ways in which a child can trust God in life's challenges. (4 marks)

25. Explain why God changed Abram's name to Abraham. (3 marks)

26. Describe how Abram showed obedience when God called him. (4 marks)

27. State three lessons from the story of Zacchaeus. (3 marks)

28. Give two lessons from the story of Balaam and his donkey. (2 marks)

29. Give two things that make each person unique. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

2. D — I will help my mother with the dishes
   Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

3. A — A decision to do one thing instead of another
   A choice means deciding between different actions.

4. C — Psalm 119:105
   Psalm 119:105 compares God's word to a lamp and a light.

5. C — It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

6. A — Respect and love among members
   Respect and love make a home peaceful.

7. A — The person who did wrong
   It is never the child's fault.

8. B — No, stop!
   Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

9. B — God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   A loving Father cares and knows us.

10. D — Isaiah 43:1
   Isaiah 43:1 says, "I have called you by name."

11. C — 27
   The New Testament has 27 books.

12. B — Isaiah 49:16
   Isaiah 49:16 uses this picture to show that God does not forget us.

13. B — Half of his possessions
   Zacchaeus said he would give half of his possessions.

14. C — They grumbled
   Luke 19:7 says they all began to mutter.

15. B — Giving it food, water and rest
   Kindness to animals includes meeting their needs.

16. A — A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   Judges were leaders who rescued Israel.

17. C — Judges
   Judges 13-16 tells about Samson.

18. D — A long time when there is not enough food
   A famine is a serious shortage of food.

19. A — Sarah
   Genesis 17:15 records this.

20. C — Following good instructions even when it is hard
   Abraham obeyed God without knowing the whole plan.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Joseph knew that wisdom comes from God. He was humble and did not boast. He gave God the honour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wisdom from God, 1 for humility, 1 for honouring God.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: He gives life, food, water and air; gives families; forgives when we are sorry; knows us by name; sent Jesus to save us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: It teaches that God is powerful, that strength and abilities are gifts from God, and that we should trust Him and be honest with parents. It does not teach children to fight lions or dangerous animals or to do dangerous things. Children should stay away from danger and call adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's power, 1 for gifts from God, 1 for trust and honesty, 1 for not fighting dangerous animals, 1 for staying safe.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray; read the Bible; ask trusted adults; do their best; thank God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: God made a covenant with him and promised that he would be a father of many nations. The new name reminded him of this promise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the covenant, 1 for the promise, 1 for the name as a reminder.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: He left his country, his people and his father's household. He went to a land he did not know. He took his wife, nephew and belongings. He was seventy-five years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves everyone, even those others reject; repentance means changing and putting things right; we should be honest with money and share with the poor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey God; do not be greedy; bless others; be kind to animals. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid answer.
